title: Baseball Game

contractDetails.constraints: 1–1000 operations. Integer tokens are in [−30000,30000]. + always has two earlier retained scores. D and C always have at least one. No explicit source bound is given for intermediate totals. Use exact integer arithmetic. The decimal-string result prevents fixed-width overflow.
contractDetails.output-checking: Return a canonical decimal string for the exact integer total. This resolves an absent intermediate bound without restricting the published input domain.

statement: Maintain a score history. A decimal integer adds that score. D adds twice the last score, + adds the sum of the last two scores, and C removes the last score. Return the exact sum of the final history as a canonical base-10 string, with a leading minus for negative totals and no redundant zeros.

hints: Conceptual: Removing a score can change what later operations refer to.
Directional: Store the retained scores in a stack.
Implementation: Apply each operation to the stack top and sum the final stack.
complexityAnalysis: O(nD) time and O(nD) auxiliary space for decimal arithmetic, where D is the maximum digit count of a score.
